lastResponse.text: Yes. This is emergency level. Call nine one one right now for a live person. Put your phone on speaker and say: “Possible overdose, slow and weird breathing, won’t stay awake.” Keep him on his side and stay with him. If breathing gets very slow or stops, start CPR. After nine one one is on the Way, I can help with detox options.
